profile.headline: TS | Full Stack Software Engineer | React.js | HTML | CSS | C# | SQL | .Net | Java | Docker | Git | Cloud Services |
profile.summary: A dedicated, experienced professional in software development, web applications, and programming. Loves the challenge of diverse projects that require creative thinking. Always interested in learning new skills and continually improving to raise current level of expertise. Highly motivated, self-confident individual, with the ability to analyze any situation and succeed under pressure, while aiming to get results with precision.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Contributed to the success of United States Air Force Joint Mission Planning Systems (JMPS-AF), Coronet Air-Refueling Planner (CARP), and Air Delivery Information Service (ADIS) by supporting the design and integration of server, windows, and web-based applications.
- Utilized a variety of developer tools to troubleshoot custom server and web-based applications, ensuring efficient system operation and client satisfaction.
- Optimized system performance by restructuring and normalizing SQL tables, reducing redundancy and optimizing stored procedures for specific data tables.
- Successfully refactored legacy VB6 applications to C# and converted web-based ASP.NET applications for scale, providing modernized front-end styling using CSS for enhanced user experience and resource management.
- Streamlined the airport update process and enhanced data accuracy through the creation of a web application tool for updating airports in the server.
- Contributed to the success of these projects through strong technical expertise and experience in software development, demonstrating proficiency in C#, ASP.NET, T-SQL, CSS, and web application development.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Created SQL Data Tables and stored procedures to handle data manipulation throughout the
application for back-end web development
-Implemented a React-Infinite-Scroll-Component to a paginated list of jobs, which allowed for a more user-friendly experience when scrolling through a large amount of data.
-Connected Data Layers Services with RESTful APIs in .NET Core to React components via AJAX request.
-Developed React Front-End Client for managing content for jobs.
-Developed RESTful.Net API service using ADO.NET in order to access SQL Stored Procedures to test all the APIs
-Built components using React.js, styled with Bootstrap, and validated inputs using Formik and Yup to allow visitors to search and select jobs available.
-Used Git and GitHub for source control and repo management.
-Collaborated with a team of 15 developers using source control and Agile methodologies,
including daily standups and code reviews.
-Used engineering software such as Visual Studio Code, for application building, and debugging

positions.title: Air Transportation Specialist
positions.description:
-Utilized strong analytical skills to track shipments within multiple databases with complex queries 
-Maintained knowledge of air transportation and dangerous goods regulations, and compliance policies 
-Maintained positive relationships with clients, vendors, and other branches to facilitate smooth operations and ensure efficient, timely shipment of cargo, equipment, and personnel 
-Created and maintained shipping documents and records
positions.insights: Critical Thinking, Interpersonal Communication and +1 skill

volunteerExperiences.description:
-Mentored and tutored at-risk youth in the community
-Assisted with homework, projects, and other schoolwork
-Helped with life skills development and positive decision making
-Encouraged and motivated youth to stay on track and reach their goals
